project_metadata.visual_style_description: Physically honest premium product cinematography: a square clear perfume bottle with amber liquid and glossy black cap, centered on a reflective dark surface, lit by a large diffused source from upper-left against a seamless warm gradient.

core_concept.title: From This.
core_concept.one_liner: A quiet luxury perfume object emerges from darkness through controlled light, glass, amber liquid, and reflection.
core_concept.artistic_intent: Preserve the still image's material truth while introducing restrained motion that keeps the cap highlight, glass refraction, liquid meniscus, and reflection physically coherent.

mood_and_tone.lighting_character: Large diffused key light from upper-left, with broad stable highlights and gentle edge illumination.
mood_and_tone.camera_personality: Locked, deliberate, product-focused; approximately 65mm perspective with a slight upward pitch.
mood_and_tone.texture_and_grain: Clean commercial image, smooth gradients, controlled micro-detail, no visible film grain.

protagonist.description: Square transparent perfume bottle filled with uniform deep amber liquid, topped by a glossy black rounded cap.
protagonist.performance_style: Static hero presence with restrained reveal or micro-parallax only.
protagonist.wardrobe_notes: None; material anchors are clear glass, amber liquid, black gloss cap, and metallic atomizer stem.

characters_and_relationships.relationship_dynamic: The product is the sole subject; light and reflection act as supporting visual partners.

subject_list.appearance_anchor: Centered square clear-glass perfume bottle, rounded black glossy cap, deep amber liquid, visible central atomizer stem.
subject_list.wardrobe_anchor: Clear glass, warm amber liquid, black gloss cap; no label or extra decoration.

core_imagery_and_symbolism.recurrence_hint: Keep the liquid level, color, and volume stable across motion.
Use a soft vertically fading reflection aligned with the bottle.
Maintain the broad cap highlight without flicker or jumping.

narrative_flow.structure_summary: Begin in a dark, quiet product space; reveal the bottle through the warm gradient and stable soft light; end on a composed hero hold where glass, amber liquid, black cap, and reflection read clearly.

act_beats.purpose: Reveal glass edges, amber fill, and cap highlight
Lock the premium product image and reflection

narrative_flow.climax_placement: Final third: the most complete and stable hero view.

scene_list.description: Centered perfume bottle on a dark reflective surface, pale gray upper background transitioning toward warm amber near the lower right.
scene_list.lighting_anchor: Large diffused upper-left key with stable soft highlights and subtle glass edge illumination.

image_analysis.cap_highlight: elongated curved rectangular band on the upper-mid front of the glossy cap
image_analysis.glass_edge: smooth gradual refractive bright edges following both curved side contours
image_analysis.liquid: deep warm amber, highly uniform and clear, level meniscus
image_analysis.reflection: soft vertical reflection beneath the bottle, strongest near contact and gradually fading downward
image_analysis.background: seamless linear warm gradient from pale gray/off-white upper area toward darker warm amber lower-right area
image_analysis.camera: approximately 65mm medium telephoto, slight upward pitch around 8 degrees
negative_risks: liquid meniscus and fill level instability
background gradient banding or drifting relative to the product
